title: SCCM Application Migration to Intune Win32 (Repackaging)
author_notes: Effort tier: T4 (repackage an SCCM-deployed application estate into Intune Win32 with detection/assignment parity, validation, coexistence; volume + risk).

Distinct from intune-win32-app-packaging-deployment (net-new packaging), sccm-intune-co-management-enablement (workload move), and the WS1 app-rebuild product; this is the SCCM-app -> Intune Win32 repackaging migration. version_directive: New; branding: off.
hook: Repackage your SCCM apps into Intune Win32 — and prove each one still deploys
problem: Moving app delivery from Configuration Manager to Intune means every SCCM application — with its detection method, requirements, dependencies, and deployment types — has to be repackaged as an Intune Win32 app and validated so nobody loses software mid-migration. Done by hand it's slow and inconsistent. This solution gives you a repeatable way to migrate the SCCM application estate to Intune Win32: inventory the SCCM apps, repackage each into .intunewin with correct detection and assignments, run coexistence during transition, and validate each before cutover.
whats_inside: Solution Overview — mapping SCCM applications (deployment types, detection methods, requirements, dependencies) to Intune Win32 apps, the repackage-and-validate model, SCCM/Intune coexistence during migration, and the ringed cutover.

Requirements Guide — every prerequisite (Intune, Configuration Manager access to export app metadata, the Win32 Content Prep Tool, source installers, a pilot group, change control) with how to verify and how to implement each if missing.

Implementation Guide — exact, ordered steps: inventory SCCM apps and deployment types, prioritize, repackage each into .intunewin with detection/requirements/dependencies, recreate assignments, run coexistence, validate deployment, cut over by ring, retire the SCCM deployment, then expand.

5 PowerShell scripts — SCCM-vs-Intune app inventory discovery, install/detection validation, a repackage-coverage and deployment-success report, safe remediation of failed installs, and an app-assignment ring group builder.
Testing & Troubleshooting Guides with explicit pass/fail gates, plus field-proven Best Practices for the assign-once, repeat-everywhere model.
short: A repeatable way to migrate the SCCM application estate to Intune Win32 — inventory SCCM apps, repackage each into .intunewin with correct detection and assignments, run coexistence, and validate each before cutover. Self-guided, tested, a fraction of consulting cost.
